native_mechanisms: Hang the two symbol strings as crossed rows/columns of lamp-posts, lighting each lattice cell (spark = match/gap-out/gap-in cost) only on demand rather than filling flat ground
Fold the lattice sheet along its slanting middle so all cells with equal row+column sum press flush into one crease (anti-diagonal equivalence class)
Read three stacked spark layers through each crease simultaneously and let the spent bottom layer drift off, keeping only the two most recent creases as the fold walks forward
core_technique: Anti-diagonal (i+j) wavefront Needleman-Wunsch with AVX2 SIMD across each diagonal, three rotating O(n) diagonal buffers, plus a score-bound-derived band clamped to be non-binding and a scalar row-DP fallback.
